scores.rationale: The report does not state self-guided exploration or flexible local experience as a decision priority.
No source or evidence class is identified for evaluating self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No named option is supported by a concrete fact about self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No named option or route has a concrete fact establishing heavily packaged or group-managed activities.
The report does not compare self-guided experiences with packaged or group-managed activities.
No option is recommended because it supports self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No otherwise viable option is downgraded for favoring packaged or group-managed activities.
The report provides no executable step implementing self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
No threshold, allocation, sequence rule, or checkpoint is specified for self-guided exploration or flexible local experience.
The report states no condition under which packaged or group-managed activities would become the better choice.
No visible chain links the specified preference to evidence and then to a decision or action.
